title: Legacy 'Service Advisor' users become 'Service Advisor' after migration
custom_preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing 'Service Advisor' user is present.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a 'Service Advisor' user.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and find that role's row.
  4. Look at the role's read-only Permission Summary (eye icon).
custom_expected:
The user's role is 'Service Advisor'.

The role's permissions match the expected set for that role.

The 'Service Advisor' role is editable (it has a pencil icon).

On the Service Advisor summary, the Timesheets card has both Create & Edit and Delete off — Service Advisors cannot edit timesheets. This is expected.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs migrated legacy users); role name/editability build-verified
evidence: Role 'Service Advisor' + editability confirmed in live roles list. Migration of legacy users needs seeded legacy accounts.
